verdicts.label: likely-bug
verdicts.rationale: The PR adds __slots__ to the internal node classes (Node, Variable, Value, Op) for performance, but does not address pickle compatibility. Existing pickled Marker objects (which contain these node instances) now raise AttributeError when unpickled because the new __slots__ prevent restoration of the instance __dict__. No tests, docs, or changelog mention this change, indicating it is an unintended regression.
evidence: None: this PR changes no tests, docs or changelog.
verdicts.facts: An object built by base from ["extra== 'test'"], pickled, then unpickled by head fails to load: builtins.AttributeError.
